mapper.insert: MERGE INTO RECON_BATCH_SOURCE T USING (SELECT #{batchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} BATCH_ID, #{source,jdbcType=VARCHAR} SOURCE_NAME, #{fileType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} FILE_TYPE FROM DUAL) S ON (T.BATCH_ID = S.BATCH_ID AND T.SOURCE_NAME = S.SOURCE_NAME AND T.FILE_TYPE = S.FILE_TYPE) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (BATCH_ID, SOURCE_NAME, FILE_TYPE, STATUS, DECLARED_PARTS, DECLARED_RECORDS, DECLARED_AMOUNT, RETRY_COUNT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{batchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{source,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, 0, 0, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT BATCH_ID, SOURCE_NAME, FILE_TYPE, STATUS, DECLARED_PARTS, DECLARED_RECORDS, DECLARED_AMOUNT, RETRY_COUNT, FAIL_REASON FROM RECON_BATCH_SOURCE WHERE BATCH_ID = #{batchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY SOURCE_NAME, FILE_TYPE
